class Queue {
  pending = new Set<Promise<void>>();
  list: Promise<void>[] = [];

  async drain(): Promise<void> {
    while (this.pending.size > 0) {
      await Promise.all([...this.pending]);
    }
  }

  async drainList(): Promise<void> {
    while (this.list.length > 0) {
      await Promise.allSettled(this.list);
    }
  }
}

async function drainLocal(pending: Promise<void>[]): Promise<void> {
  while (pending.length > 0) {
    await Promise.all(pending);
  }
}

async function drainSet(pending: Set<Promise<void>>): Promise<void> {
  while (pending.size > 0) {
    await Promise.allSettled([...pending]);
  }
}

async function otherCollection(a: Promise<void>[], b: Promise<void>[]): Promise<void> {
  while (a.length > 0) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await Promise.all(b);
  }
}

async function secondStatement(a: Promise<void>[]): Promise<void> {
  let count = 0;
  while (a.length > 0) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await Promise.all(a);
    count += 1;
  }
}

async function oneItem(a: Promise<void>[]): Promise<void> {
  while (a.length > 0) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await a[0];
  }
}

async function doWhile(a: Promise<void>[]): Promise<void> {
  do {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await Promise.all(a);
  } while (a.length > 0);
}
